title: Getting Around by Vehicle: busszal, villamossal

sections.title: Reusing -val/-vel
sections.content: To say which vehicle you're using, reuse -val/-vel ("with") the same way you did for cooking tools: busz → busszal, villamos → villamossal, metró → metróval. Combine it with megy or jön: Busszal megyek dolgozni. ("I go to work by bus.")

items.english: I go to university by bus.
I'd rather go by tram than by metro.

sections.content: busz and villamos assimilate the -val/-vel like every other consonant-final word you've seen: busz + val → busszal, not "buszval".
